scoring_justification: Band gaps are produced by a heavy DFT self-consistent calculation; full recompute is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Compare agent-reported gaps to paper values with tolerances and structural trends.

hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's reported SE‑RSH band gaps

outputs.description: Fundamental band gaps in eV for Si (diamond), SiO2 (α-quartz), c-BN (zincblende), and monolayer h-BN, computed with the SE-RSH functional.

output_contract.notes: Tolerance and trend checks are defined in the hidden grading specification. The agent should use the described functional and public structures without empirical fitting.
